from build123d import *
import cadlib

PARAMS = {"hole_d": 4.2}

base = load_mesh_solid()
bb = base.bounding_box()
hole = Pos(0, 0, bb.min.Z - 1.0) * Cylinder(
    radius=PARAMS["hole_d"] / 2,
    height=bb.size.Z + 2.0,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)
result = cadlib.mesh_cut(base, hole)
